title: Cash Pickup Activity and Mobile Wallet Resend Rates
content:
Training Q&A on how a customer's **Cash Pickup** sending lifts the rate of a **Mobile Wallet** resend.

**Uplift rule.** The Cash Pickup uplift on a resend follows the principal of the customer's Cash Pickup payments collected in the last 6 calendar months, that is the amounts of their Cash Pickup funds-received entries in that window:

| Cash Pickup principal collected in the window (USD) | Cash Pickup uplift |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 or more | 0.10 points |
| at least 300.00 and below 1000.00 | 0.05 points |
| below 300.00 | nothing |

The window is rolling: it holds the entries whose entry date lies fewer than 6 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

### Questions the rule answers
**Which Cash Pickup records count?** The customer's Cash Pickup funds-received entries, that is principal collected for Cash Pickup transfers, inside the window.

**Today is 2026-09-10. Does a Cash Pickup payment collected on 2026-03-11 count?** The calendar-month difference is 6 and today's day (10) is lower than 11, so the whole months are 5: it is inside the window. A payment collected on 2026-03-10 gives 6 whole months and is outside.

**Payments of 250.00 and 50.00 inside the window?** They total 300.00: 0.05 points.

**One payment of 1000.00 inside the window?** 0.10 points.
